origin: Independent checker found the legacy strict-bound epsilon issue after source/contract freeze; root approved this bounded internal exact-bound extension before runtime implementation.
representation: Existing extract_threshold_conditions gains optional exact_stat mode. For that statistic, numerical bounds remain unshifted and min_inclusive/max_inclusive booleans retain the parsed operator. Default legacy dictionaries and epsilon behavior remain unchanged. Exact flags live only inside existing internal yes_no note checks, not public request fields or route conditions.
comparison: Compare integer source seconds against decimal minute bounds times60, honoring explicit inclusivity. Do not reverse-engineer operator semantics from an epsilon-adjusted number.
source_grain: source_minutes must be finite, positive and within serialization tolerance of integer seconds; no rounded canonical minutes or arbitrary fractional-second source precision.
